contract.title: Your commitment contract
contract.intro: This contract sums up what you commit to for this budget cycle. Once signed it cannot be edited.
contract.item.supervision_text: Focus monitoring only runs in the windows you set. Video never leaves your device.
contract.item.penalties_text: Penalties rest only on hard facts, follow your thresholds and weekly cap, and can be appealed.
contract.item.trial_text: Signing starts a trial in which penalties are suspended and nothing is charged.
contract.loosening: Tightening a rule applies at once. Loosening one applies from the next week, or the next cycle for budget rules.
contract.agree: I have read the contract and commit to it.
contract.error.sign: Could not sign the contract. Please try again.
contract.error.complete: The contract is signed, but setup could not be completed. Please try again.
contract.error.no_cycle: Your budget cycle is not ready yet. Go back and try again.
